[[Tarnok's Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Tarnok Forgerunner]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (vs. [[elemental damage]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Feathered Longbow]].
